methods_proposed.name: ARIMA
methods_proposed.description: Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average for time series forecasting
methods_proposed.implementation_code:
def predict_arima(train_df, test_df, target_col, date_col, **params):
    from statsmodels.tsa.arima.model import ARIMA
    import pandas as pd
    model = ARIMA(train_df[target_col], order=(1,1,1))
    results = model.fit()
    forecast = results.forecast(steps=len(test_df))
    return pd.DataFrame({"predicted": forecast})

methods_proposed.description: Tree-based ensemble using engineered features for forecasting
methods_proposed.implementation_code:
def predict_random_forest(train_df, test_df, target_col, date_col, **params):
    from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestRegressor
    import pandas as pd
    features = ["Area", "Yield", "lag_1", "lag_2", "rolling_mean_3"]
    X_train = train_df[features]
    y_train = train_df[target_col]
    X_test = test_df[features]
    model = RandomForestRegressor(n_estimators=100, random_state=42)
    model.fit(X_train, y_train)
    preds = model.predict(X_test)
    return pd.DataFrame({"predicted": preds})
